name: endnote-for-word
description: Insert and validate native EndNote CWYW citations and bibliographies in Word documents, driven by a reviewable JSON manifest.

interface.shortDescription: Native EndNote CWYW citations and bibliographies in Word.
interface.longDescription: Drives desktop EndNote Cite While You Write through Word COM automation to produce genuine ADDIN EN.CITE citation fields with a traveling library and an ADDIN EN.REFLIST bibliography, plus read-only library search, manifest pre-checks, output-style switching, and structural validation.
defaultPrompt: Search my EndNote library and cite these references in this Word document.
Replace the citation markers in this DOCX with native EndNote CWYW fields.
Change this document's EndNote output style to IEEE and rebuild the bibliography.
Validate the EndNote citations and bibliography in this Word file.
